Method of Attack: Exploiting unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in Zoho ServiceDesk Plus to drop a webshell
Uploading an executable (msiexec.exe) and launching payload remotely without authentication
Installing a variant of the Godzilla webshell as an Apache Tomcat Java Servlet Filter to bypass security filters
Impacted Systems: Zoho ServiceDesk Plus versions 11305 and older
Attack Vector: Unauthenticated REST API requests to vulnerable Zoho ServiceDesk Plus server
Indicators of Compromise: Use of same webshell secret key as in ADSelfService Plus campaign
Presence of Godzilla webshell filter in Apache Tomcat process
